title: Pakistani Provinces and ICT by Sex Ratio
desc: Males per 100 females, as reported in Pakistan Census 2023 Table 1.

source.name: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics — 7th Population and Housing Census 2023, Table 1 (National)
source.license: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics official statistical publication
source.note: AllRanks assistant verified on 2026-10-22 against the linked PBS original Table 1 PDF, including all five named administrative units and the corresponding columns. Rural/urban subtotal rows and the Pakistan national aggregate are excluded. PBS Table 1 does not include Azad Jammu and Kashmir or Gilgit-Baltistan, so neither is imputed. Population table note: figures include headcounts from restricted areas for which detailed demographic and housing data were not received.
